scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.install:browsers: npm exec -w backend -- playwright install chromium
scripts.dev:py: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.setup:py: cd backend-py && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt && python -m playwright install chromium
